[[Floater (Fallout 76)|Floaters]] |robots = |quests = |terminal = |cell name =WillardCorporateHousingExt |refid ={{ID|00262cbd}} |crafting ={{Crafting stations FO76 |weapons =yes |tinkering =yes }} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionToxicValley}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeWhiteCollar}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} |edid =SubToxicWillardCorporateHousingLocation }} '''Willard Corporate Housing''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Toxic Valley]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== Located southeast of [[Wavy Willard's Water Park]], in the corrosive, toxic environment of the valley. These trailer homes were used by the staff of the amusement park for housing but are long-abandoned, now serving as a source of meager salvage. ==Layout== There is a [[tinker's workbench]] located in one house to the east. A [[Cooking station (Fallout 76)|cooking station]] sits in the middle of the ruins. A [[Weapons workbench (Fallout 76)|weapons workbench]] is located behind a house to the right of the cooking station's position. ==Notable loot== * [[Darius Angler's manifesto, part 3]] - Holotape, on a desk near a broken [[terminal]], at the house to the left of the cooking station. * [[Darius Angler's manifesto, part 4]] - Holotape, on a desk in front of a broken terminal, at the house to the left of the cooking station. * [[Darius Angler's manifesto, part 5]] - Note, on top of a toilet lid, in the house closest to the cliff's edge. * Potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] - In the trailer just north of the roundabout and cooking station, on the metal desk by the ruined terminal. * Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] - In the middle of the trailer park, on the park logo roundabout, on the half-buried green [[Golf cart (Fallout 76)|golf cart]]. * Potential [[Fallout 76 weapon mods|weapon mod]] - In the back of an orange golf cart. * Potential [[Fallout 76 recipes|recipe]] - In the northeastern house, atop a kitchen counter. ==Appearances== Willard Corporate Housing appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== FO76 Willard corporate housing top.png|Willard Corporate Housing, as seen from the roof of one of its homes. RELAY TOWER EM-B1-27'''''
''This small hilltop military relay tower has a parked APC and possible access to a Vertibot drop."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) ==Layout== This is a standard radio relay tower with [[Automated turret (Fallout 4)|machine gun turrets]] guarding the perimeter and its two entrances to the north and west. Inside is a blue [[Relay tower EM-B1-27 terminal entries|system relay terminal]] which US government supply requisition holotapes can be loaded into. There is a set of lockers in its southeastern corner and two [[First aid (Fallout 76)|first aid]] on a shelf directly in front of the western entrance (one is locked - [[Picklock]] 0). ==Notable loot== * [[AUTOMATED RECORD 0000002]] - Holotape, found in a crate designated "Mysterious Box" directly west of the relay tower. * [[Volunteers needed!]] - Note, found on the body of a [[Responder]] Volunteer near a house outside of the relay tower. * [[Fusion core (Fallout 76)|Fusion core]] - On top of the central control panel, along the wall closest to the repairable terminal. ==Related quest== * [[Request Government Air Drop]] - A [[US government supply requisition]] holotape can be used in the relay tower terminal. * [[Always Vigilant]] - Defend Rover while he conducts repairs to the relay tower. * [[Hunter for Hire]] - Load the [[broadcast tape]] into the relay tower terminal. ==Appearances== Relay tower EM-B1-27 appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:The Forest locations]] [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[fr:Tour relais EM-B1-27]] [[ru:Релейная вышка EM-B1-27]] [[uk:Ретрансляційна вежа EM-B1-27]] [[zh:轉送塔EM-B1-27]]

{{Infobox incomplete|FO76}} {{Infobox location |games =FO76 |type =unmarked |image =FO76 Sludge trailer 01.png |map marker =(nearest: [[Red Rocket filling station]]) |map marker image =Red rocket filling station map.png |local map = |part of =[[Ash Heap]], [[Appalachia]] |creatures =[[Opossum]]s |robots = |quests =[[Fly Swatter|Event: Fly Swatter]] |cell name = |refid = }} The '''sludge trailer'''''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide]]'' p. 394: ''"'''The Ash Heap (Zone B) - Secondary Locations'''''
31. Sludge Trailer: ''A rusting metal trailer with junk to gather, a place to sleep, and an outdoor space best described as 'gunky.'"''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in the [[Ash Heap]] region of [[Appalachia]]. It is situated immediately north of and behind the [[Red Rocket filling station]]. ==Layout== This location consists of a small metal trailer and a nearby pile of sludge, with disposed tires and an [[off-road vehicle]] (with some coffee-related [[Fallout 76 junk items|junk items]] on the hood) in the vicinity. The area is populated by [[opossum]]s roaming the area surrounding the trailer. Two [[Toolbox (Fallout 76)|toolboxes]] can be looted in the exterior of the trailer, one of which is near a [[Pick-R-Up truck (Fallout 76)|Pick-R-Up]], while the other is near a [[dirt bike]] in the ground. Inside the trailer, there is a [[Bed (Fallout 76)|bed]] that can be slept in, as well as an [[explosives crate]] to search. On the right side of the trailer is a TV set and lawn chair, with a [[Teddy bear (Fallout 76)|teddy bear]] sitting in the chair. ==Related quest== * [[Fly Swatter|Event: Fly Swatter]] - An instance of this event may occur near the sludge trailer. ==Notes== The sludge trailer is a possible location to wake up in after drinking [[Nukashine]]. ==Appearances== The sludge trailer appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== FO76 Sludge trailer 02.png FO76 Sludge trailer 03.png|Relaxing teddy bear FO76 Sludge trailer 04.png|Bed ==References== {{References}} '''Non-game''' {{References|group="Non-game"}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 unmarked locations]] [[Category:Ash Heap locations]]
